text: You see Leon, a guard.
source_text: You see Leon, a guard.

text: What is your business here?
source_text: What is your business here?

text: I must speak with Mr. Hightower.
source_text: I must speak with Mr. Hightower.

text: I've come to kill Mr. Hightower.
source_text: I've come to kill Mr. Hightower.

text: What business is it of yours?
source_text: What business is it of yours?

text: Ok.  But I'm watching you.  He's in his office.
source_text: Ok.  But I'm watching you.  He's in his office.

text: Thank you.
source_text: Thank you.

text: Yeah... I bet you're watching me.
source_text: Yeah... I bet you're watching me.

text: I don't like your attitude.  I'm going to have to ask you to leave.
source_text: I don't like your attitude.  I'm going to have to ask you to leave.

text: I'll leave when I'm good and ready, pal!
source_text: I'll leave when I'm good and ready, pal!

text: Ok, I'll leave.
source_text: Ok, I'll leave.

text: Attitude?  I'l show you attitude!!!
source_text: Attitude?  I'l show you attitude!!!

text: Whatever it is, you can tell me.  Mr. H is busy right now.
source_text: Whatever it is, you can tell me.  Mr. H is busy right now.

text: Why do you have to be so difficult?
source_text: Why do you have to be so difficult?

text: I would much rather tell him in person.  It's a matter of life and death.
source_text: I would much rather tell him in person.  It's a matter of life and death.

text: Decker has put a contract out on Hightower's life.
source_text: Decker has put a contract out on Hightower's life.

text: You can tell me, or you can leave.
source_text: You can tell me, or you can leave.

text: Who died and made you God?
source_text: Who died and made you God?

text: Decker has put a contract out on Hightower's life.
source_text: Decker has put a contract out on Hightower's life.

text: Look, I'm not tellin' you a damn thing!
source_text: Look, I'm not tellin' you a damn thing!

text: I'll leave.
source_text: I'll leave.

text: Again?  What a fool Decker is.  Well?... I guess he's not as big a fool as the guys he hires for these jobs.  See here, check out my gun.
source_text:
Again?  What a fool Decker is.  Well?... I guess he's not as big a fool as the guys he hires for these jobs.  See here,
 check out my gun.

text: [Leon shows you the side of his gun where 5 deep scratch marks are visible.]
source_text: [Leon shows you the side of his gun where 5 deep scratch marks are visible.]

text: Each one of these marks is for a past attempt on Hightower's life.  I bagged each and every one of them.  Tell me... do you know what this fool Decker hired looks like?
source_text:
Each one of these marks is for a past attempt on Hightower's life.  I bagged each and every one of them.  Tell me...
 do you know what this fool Decker hired looks like?

text: No.
source_text: No.

text: It's me, you idiot!
source_text: It's me, you idiot!

text: Hey! Wow!  You've got scratch marks on your gun!  You're coooooool!
source_text: Hey! Wow!  You've got scratch marks on your gun!  You're coooooool!

text: Thank you for the advance warning, but Mr. Hightower doesn't like strangers hangin' around.  I'm going to have to ask you to leave.
source_text:
Thank you for the advance warning, but Mr. Hightower doesn't like strangers hangin' around.  I'm going
 to have to ask you to leave.

text: That's it?  No reward? What the hell is wrong with you people?
source_text: That's it?  No reward? What the hell is wrong with you people?

text: You're welcome.  Goodbye.
source_text: You're welcome.  Goodbye.

text: Mr. Hightower is not taking any visitors.  Now leave!
source_text: Mr. Hightower is not taking any visitors.  Now leave!

text: I'll leave when I'm good and ready, pal!
source_text: I'll leave when I'm good and ready, pal!

text: Ok, I'll leave.
source_text: Ok, I'll leave.

text: I really need to speak to Mr. Hightower.
source_text: I really need to speak to Mr. Hightower.

text: Ok, buddy.  Let's go. [Leon grabs you by the arm.]
source_text: Ok, buddy.  Let's go. [Leon grabs you by the arm.]

text: Get your damn hands off of me!
source_text: Get your damn hands off of me!

text: All right, all right!  I'm going.
source_text: All right, all right!  I'm going.

text: Wait!  I'm not finished!
source_text: Wait!  I'm not finished!

text: Ug!
source_text: Ug!

text: Rookl!
source_text: Rookl!

text: I have urgent news for Mr. Hightower.
source_text: I have urgent news for Mr. Hightower.

text: What are you doing here?  I'm off duty now.  Go bother someone else.
source_text: What are you doing here?  I'm off duty now.  Go bother someone else.

text: I was hoping your sorry hide would wander around here sometime!  Guards!
source_text: I was hoping your sorry hide would wander around here sometime!  Guards!
